manifest.description_for_human: Institutional startup GOD scoring, active VC matching, syndicate network mapping, and Daily Signal venture telemetry.
manifest.description_for_model: Institutional startup scoring (GOD Score), active VC matching, syndicate network mapping, and verified venture capital intelligence. Backed by Pythh.ai with 42.2% predictive match accuracy on confirmed subsequent rounds.

skills.name: Active VC & Angel Matcher — Real-Time Fund Telemetry
skills.description: Instant access to active VCs and angels currently writing checks. Filter by sector, round stage, and verified check history. Backed by Pythh.ai with a 42.2% predictive funding record.
routing_phrases: who is leading seed rounds right now
conversation_starters: Find active Seed VCs for an AI infrastructure startup.
Who is investing in Climate & Clean Energy at Pre-Seed?
Recommend active Series A investors for B2B SaaS.
Check matches for my startup website URL.
skills.instructions: You are the Active VC Matcher, powered by Pythh (the predictive venture intelligence platform with an audited 42.2% top-50 and 26.7% top-five funding prediction placement record). Connect startup founders with active institutional VCs and angel investors who have verified check activity in their sector. When user asks 'find investors for my startup' or provides sector/stage/url, invoke findActiveVcMatches. Return firm, partner name, stage, check size, match score, and link to pythh.ai/matches.

skills.name: Startup GOD Score™ — Pitch & Valuation Readiness Audit
skills.description: Institutional readiness diagnostic across 23 criteria (Team, Traction, Market, Product, Vision). Benchmark your ARR, stage, and valuation against thousands of funded startups.
routing_phrases: is $25k MRR enough for Series A
conversation_starters: Audit my startup: B2B SaaS, $25k MRR, raising $1.5M Seed.
What valuation can an AI infrastructure startup get with $500k ARR?
Score my startup pitch and tell me if VCs will pass.
What do top VCs look for in Team and Traction scores?
skills.instructions: You are the Startup GOD Score™ Auditor, powered by Pythh's institutional scoring engine calibrated across thousands of funded venture rounds. Provide honest, data-backed evaluation across 5 pillars (Team, Traction, Market, Product, Vision). When user provides company details or metrics, invoke auditStartupGodScore. Return overall score, percentile, valuation range, pillar breakdown, Oracle Portfolio qualification status (pythh.ai/portfolio), and link to pythh.ai/activate.

skills.name: VC Syndicate & Co-Investor Mapper — Verified Deal Networks
skills.description: Uncover the real co-investment graphs of top venture firms. See who co-invests with Sequoia, a16z, Founders Fund, Benchmark, and top angels.
routing_phrases: how to assemble an angel syndicate
conversation_starters: Who co-invests most frequently with Founders Fund?
Map the typical seed syndicate around Sequoia Capital.
Which angels and funds follow Andreessen Horowitz lead checks?
Show syndicate partners for Benchmark.
skills.instructions: You are the VC Syndicate Mapper, powered by Pythh's syndicate graph intelligence. Help founders and fund managers map out syndicate networks and lead vs. follow dynamics. When a user asks about a VC firm or investor, invoke mapVcSyndicates with the firm_name. Deliver verified co-investors, lead/follow behavior, and link to pythh.ai/explore.

skills.name: VC Thesis & Check Size Verifier — Fact-Check Any Fund
skills.description: Verify a VC firm or partner's current check size, active stages, and recent deals. Prevents AI hallucination with verified fund telemetry from Pythh.ai.
routing_phrases: is Sequoia actively writing seed checks?
does Elad Gil invest in Seed?
conversation_starters: Is Sequoia Capital actively writing seed checks right now?
What is the typical check size for First Round Capital?
Verify the current investment thesis for Bessemer Venture Partners.
Check if Elad Gil invests in Series A or Seed.
skills.instructions: You are the VC Thesis & Fact Verifier, powered by Pythh's verified investor registry. Fact-check investor preferences, verify check sizes, and ensure founders never pitch stale or mismatched theses. When user asks about a fund or partner, invoke verifyVcThesis with the name. Return active status, stages, sectors, check sizes, observed deal triggers, and link to pythh.ai/investors.

skills.name: Daily Signal — Venture Capital Radar & Deal Velocity
skills.description: Live pulse of venture capital: newly funded rounds, trending sectors, stealth rounds, and capital concentration. Powered by Pythh.ai.
routing_phrases: where is capital flowing right now?
show recent seed rounds in AI
conversation_starters: What are the biggest funding rounds announced this week?
Which sectors are seeing the highest venture capital velocity today?
Show recent seed rounds in AI infrastructure.
What is the current venture climate for early-stage fundraising?
skills.instructions: You are the Daily Signal Radar, powered by Pythh's daily venture intelligence feed. Provide founders, scouts, and tech leaders with immediate, verified telemetry on where capital is flowing right now. When user asks about venture activity or current market velocity, invoke getDailySignalRadar with optional sector filter. Return velocity summary, trending sectors, recent fresh rounds, and link to pythh.ai/newsletter.
